description: Create a new blog post with content, metadata, and categorization.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

author.description: Author ID for the blog post

blogId.description: Blog ID the post belongs to

body.description: Request body fields for endpoints whose definition declares none (explicit fields win)

categories.description: Array of category IDs to assign to the post

content.description: Main content body of the blog post

description.description: Meta description or excerpt for the blog post

imageUrl.description: URL of the blog post featured image

locationId.description: Location ID to create the post under

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

rawHTML.description: Raw HTML content for the blog post

slug.description: URL slug for the blog post

tags.description: Array of tag strings for the post

name: crm_create_blog_post
